item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. Visibility will still be relatively low in some areas. With a southerly airstream affecting the coastal areas gradually in the latter part of this week, the weather will be relatively humid over the region. It will be hot during the day. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to Guangdong towards the weekend. The trough of low pressure will weaken early next week. The weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong.
